whyCard.title: 为什么先攻写作
lines: Part 6+7 只需写 60 个词，却占 30/60 分——全卷性价比最高的地方。
你的中文结构感已经很好（作文有「细节描写很精彩」「描写优美含蓄耐人寻味」的评语）——缺的是词，不是能力。

part6.name: Part 6 · 短邮件/便条
part6.rule: 25 词以上，15 分。题目给三个要点，必须全部回应（Content 维度）。

template.title: 原创结构模板
steps: ① 称呼：Hi + 名字,（别忘逗号）
③ 回应要点 2（一句，试着用 because 给个理由）
④ 回应要点 3（一句，可用 then / and 连接）
⑤ 结尾：See you! / Love, + 你的名字
template.connectors: 连接词优先 because / then——一个 because 就能把 Organisation 分抬起来

tips: 三个要点缺一个，Content 直接掉档——写完数一遍
25 词是下限不是目标，写到 30-40 词最稳
不确定的词换成会拼的词：拼错不如换词

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Katy.

Hi! My birthday party is on Saturday afternoon at my house. Can you come? What present would you like to bring me? And how will you get here?
Katy

sample.text:
Hi Katy,
Yes, I can come to your party! I want to bring you a picture book because you love reading. My dad will drive me to you house. See you on Saturday!
Love, Mei
sample.note: 31 词，三个要点全回应。有一处小错（you house → your house），不挡意思——这样也能拿 Language Band 5。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Dan.

Let's watch a film this weekend! Which film do you want to see? Which day is better for you, Saturday or Sunday? Shall we eat something after the film?
Dan

sample.text:
Hi Dan,
Great idea! I want to see the new cartoon about a space dog. Sunday is better for me because I have a violin lesson on Saturday. After the film, let's eat noodles!
From, Leo
sample.note: 36 词，because 给理由抬高 Organisation 分。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Sofia.

I hear you have a great book about animals. Can I borrow it? When can you bring it to school? How long can I keep it?
Sofia

sample.text:
Hi Sofia,
Of course you can borrow my animal book! I will bring it to school on Monday morning. You can keep it for two weeks. I hope you like the pictures of pandas!
Love, Kiki
sample.note: 35 词，三要点清楚，结尾加一句友好的话很自然。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Harry.

I hear you have a new bike! What colour is it? Who gave it to you? Where do you like riding it?
Harry

sample.text:
Hi Harry,
My new bike is blue and white. My grandpa gave it to me for my birthday. I like riding it in the park near my home because the road there is very safe.
From, Dong
sample.note: 36 词。全部一般现在+一般过去，简单但清楚。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Emma.

Our class is going to the zoo next Friday! Do you want to sit with me on the bus? Which animal do you want to see first? What food will you bring?
Emma

sample.text:
Hi Emma,
Yes, I want to sit with you on the bus! I want to see the elephants first because they are so big. I will bring some apples and a sandwich.
See you, Mia
sample.note: 33 词。注意三个问题一个都不能丢。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Jack.

There is a new sports class at school on Wednesdays. Do you want to join it with me? What sport do you like best? What should we wear?
Jack

sample.text:
Hi Jack,
Yes! Let's join the sports class together. I like ping-pong best because I play with my dad every weekend. We should wear sports shoes and a T-shirt.
From, Leo
sample.note: 31 词。should 表建议，KET 考纲内。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Anna.

I hear there is a concert at your school soon! When is it? What will you play? Can I come and watch?
Anna

sample.text:
Hi Anna,
Our concert is on Friday evening at six. I will play the violin with my orchestra. Of course you can come! It is free. I am a little nervous but very happy.
Love, Yuan
sample.note: 35 词。最后一句加感受，让邮件更像真人写的。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Tom.

Let's have a picnic in the park! Which park shall we go to? What food can you bring? What games shall we play there?
Tom

sample.text:
Hi Tom,
Let's go to the river park because there is a lot of grass. I can bring bread, bananas and juice. We can play badminton there — I have two rackets!
See you, Jack
sample.note: 33 词。because + 细节，两个维度都加分。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Lily.

I was ill this week and I missed school. What did we learn in the English class? Is there any homework? Can you help me on the weekend?
Lily

sample.text:
Hi Lily,
I am sorry you were ill! In English class we learned ten new words about weather. The homework is to write five sentences. I can come to your home on Saturday and help you.
Love, Mei
sample.note: 38 词。开头一句关心，Content 之外还很暖。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Ben.

The winter holiday is coming! Where will you go? Who will you go with? What do you want to do there?
Ben

sample.text:
Hi Ben,
In the winter holiday I will go to Harbin with my mum and dad. I want to see the ice houses and play in the snow. I will take a lot of photos for you!
From, Dong
sample.note: 37 词。will 表将来，全程不转调。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Grace.

Happy New Year! What present did you get? Who gave it to you? Why do you like it?
Grace

sample.text:
Hi Grace,
Happy New Year! I got a music box and my aunt gave it to me. I like it because it play a beautiful song when I open it. It is on my desk now.
Love, Kiki
sample.note: 36 词。有一处小错（it play → it plays），第三人称 -s 属灰区错误，不挡意思——照样能拿 Band 5。

tasks.prompt:
Read the email from your English friend Sam.

My family visited the science museum and it was great! Do you want to go there? Which day are you free? How much is the ticket for students?
Sam

sample.text:
Hi Sam,
Yes, I really want to go to the science museum! I am free on Sunday afternoon. The student ticket is ten yuan — very cheap! Let's meet at the bus stop at two.
From, Mia
sample.note: 35 词。最后主动约时间地点，Interactive 的好习惯。

part7.name: Part 7 · 三幅图写故事
part7.rule: 35 词以上，15 分。据三幅图写一个完整小故事。

template.title: 一图一句起步法
steps: ① 先定调：故事发生在过去 → 每个动词都盖过去戳
② 图 1 一句：谁 + 在哪 + 做什么（One day, ...）
③ 图 2 一到两句：发生了什么变化（Then / Suddenly, ...）
④ 图 3 一到两句：结果怎样（Finally / At last, ...）
⑤ 写完自查：把每个动词圈出来，问「它是过去形状吗」
template.connectors: One day → Then / Suddenly → Finally，三个时间词就是故事骨架

tips: 时态一致是命门——中途转调（过去→现在）是红区错误
人物起个名字（Tom, Lily），代词就不会乱
35 词下限 ≈ 5-6 句短句，别憋长句

scoring.title: 评分三维（要点转述，非官方原文）

dims.name: Content 内容
dims.desc: 要点是否全回应（P6 三个要点 / P7 三幅图都讲到）

dims.name: Organisation 组织
dims.desc: 句子是否连起来（连接词 because / then / and 的作用就在这）

dims.name: Language 语言
dims.desc: 词汇语法是否够用。满分档允许错误明显，只要意思仍可判断

scoring.bandNote: ★ 事实卡：Band 5（满分档）允许错误明显、意思清楚。目标不是零错误，是不写「挡住意思」的错误。

checklist.title: 写完自评清单（原创改写版）
items: 字数够了吗？（P6 ≥25 词，P7 ≥35 词）
动词时态从头到尾一个调吗？（P7 命门）
be 动词都在吗？（I am happy，不是 I happy）
用了至少一个连接词吗？（because / then / and / but）

wi.title: 一键批改：Write & Improve
wi.blurb: 剑桥官方免费在线写作批改，作文打上去几秒出反馈 + CEFR 等级 + 语法错误直接标出。家长不用会判英文作文，机器判得比大多数家长准。

speaking.title: 口语练习角（隔日 15 分钟）
speaking.note: 官方提示：不要背套话——背出来不自然，而且答不到被问的具体问题。练思路：答案 + because + 一个细节。

part1Questions.q: What's your name? How do you spell it?
part1Questions.hint: 练拼自己的名字，考试第一题就是它
I live in … + 一个细节（with my family / near a park）

part1Questions.q: What subjects do you study at school?
part1Questions.hint: 说两三科 + I like … best because …

part1Questions.q: Tell me something about your family.
part1Questions.hint: 长回答题：说 2-3 句，人数 + 谁 + 一件小事

part1Questions.q: What do you do after school?
part1Questions.hint: 练习乐器的事随时可说：I practise the violin…

part1Questions.q: What music do you like? Why?
part1Questions.hint: because it makes me happy / I play it in the orchestra

part1Questions.q: Tell me something about your best friend.
part1Questions.hint: 名字 + 认识多久 + 一起做什么

part1Questions.q: What did you do last weekend?
part1Questions.hint: 注意全用过去式——考官在听时态

part2Practice.desc: Part 2 是看图讨论喜好：练「五样东西说喜欢/不喜欢 + 理由」
topics: 五种运动（swimming / football / running / ping-pong / skating）：Do you like…? Why?
五种食物（noodles / pizza / fish / ice cream / vegetables）
五个地方（park / cinema / library / zoo / beach）
五种课余活动（reading / drawing / playing music / computer games / cooking）
part2Practice.frame: I like … because … / I don't like … because … / What about you?（把球传给对方也算分——Interactive Communication）
